hana: heads-up I opened a small docs hotfix to surface the auth outage status link + a concise workaround for transient 401s. need a quick reviewer + docs-preview pass before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/458

omar: grabbing it now. which statuspage URL should we add?

hana: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-auth-outage-5 — will add a highlighted callout to /docs/known-issues.md and a short follow-up note in /docs/operational/incident-response.md

jess: saw the PR. small request: use the async python example as primary since that's what new customers will use; keep the curl sample under "legacy clients".

hana: done, added async first and curl fallback. also added a one-line explanation for why async is preferred (non-blocking retries).

omar: preview build failing: MDX rendering error in callout. we used a markdown link inside a custom admonition that expects raw URLs. switching to a plain URL line or an HTML anchor should fix it. :wrench:

hana: updated to raw URL in the callout:

> Incident status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-auth-outage-5

and included this async snippet in the workaround section:

```python
from redwood.async_client import AsyncRedwoodClient
import asyncio

async def safe_generate():
    client = AsyncRedwoodClient(api_key="<REDACTED>")
    # Workaround: exponential backoff on 401s while auth caches rotate
    for attempt in range(5):
        try:
            return await client.generate("Hello")
        except UnauthorizedError:
            await asyncio.sleep(2 ** attempt)
```

kept the curl example below under "legacy clients" heading.

preview-bot: docs-preview: build succeeded (preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-458)

jess: added as reviewer, approving after product quick-check. tagging @mike for product tone.

mike: quick skim: wording is OK, prefer concrete phrasing — change "we are investigating" to "we rotated auth cache; some users saw brief 401s". otherwise LGTM.

hana: applied mike's wording change and pushed.

omar: preview looks good now. approved.

jess: approving. go ahead and merge+backport to the stable release branch. please include the preview link in the PR description for support.

hana: merged to main and backported to release/2026-03. added entry to /internal/changelog.md: "docs hotfix: auth outage status link + workaround (PR #458)" and pinged #support-squad with the preview URL and stable backport note.

support-squad: acknowledged — will reference the docs update when triaging any ongoing cases.

hana: thanks everyone. will follow up in the incident postmortem linking to the docs change and the Statuspage entry. closing thread. :pray:
